takeaway: A person's joint angles copied onto a robot of other proportions put its hand on a skewed path, while the hand's own motion, replayed from wherever the robot's hand is, draws the same stroke, which is why human and robot data can share relative end-effector actions.
sentence: Copying the path of a person's hand preserves the drawing across different arm sizes, while copying joint angles distorts it.
reason: Both contrast preserving a hand's path across different arm proportions with distortion from copied joint angles.
